barcodeScanner.title: Scan a barcode
barcodeScanner.hint: Point the rear camera at the barcode. Hold your phone steady and use good lighting.
barcodeScanner.scanning: The recognized barcode will be filled in automatically.
barcodeScanner.privacy: Recognition runs on your device. Video is not sent to the server.
barcodeScanner.permissionDenied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings. If the app is embedded, open it in a separate tab. You can also enter the barcode manually.
barcodeScanner.noCamera: No camera found. Enter the barcode manually.
barcodeScanner.cameraBusy: The camera is unavailable or busy in another app. Close that app and try again.
barcodeScanner.httpsRequired: Camera access requires a secure HTTPS connection. Enter the barcode manually.
barcodeScanner.unsupported: This browser does not support camera access. Use another browser or enter the barcode manually.
barcodeScanner.failed: The camera could not start or was disconnected. Retry or enter the barcode manually.
barcodeScanner.nativeUnavailable: The native scanner is unavailable: Google Play services are missing or the scanning module failed to install. Enter the barcode manually.

exchange.title: Data export and import
exchange.exportHint: Download your inventory as a spreadsheet or a full JSON backup.
exchange.privacyNote: Full JSON excludes accounts, passwords and sessions. Photos are exported as links, not embedded.
exchange.importHint: Choose an XLSX or JSON file (max 5 MB). You will see a preview first; nothing is changed until you confirm. Import never overwrites or deletes.
exchange.excelHint: Excel: sheet "Купить" becomes the shopping list, sheets М2..М12 become categories, and columns "Кол-во дома" / "Кол-во гараж" become separate stock records in locations "Дом" / "Гараж".
exchange.mode_skip_hint: Items with the same name, SKU, barcode, category, location, unit, tags and description are skipped. Existing prices and quantities are not updated.
exchange.mode_add_hint: Appends all inventory and shopping entries, including duplicates. Matching reference records are reused.
exchange.confirm: I reviewed the preview and want to import exactly this data.
exchange.importFailed: Import failed. The preview is kept; you can retry.
